intro: Between 13 April and 1 May 2026, ZCyberNews published 23 articles on cloud security. Coverage tracked APT41 activity and the critical-severity vulnerability CVE-2026-33413, which carries a CVSS score of 8.8. The reporting spanned high and critical severity incidents, with 14 high-severity and 2 critical-severity events documented. Affected sectors included technology, cloud-services, government, healthcare, and cloud services, while observed regions were Global and Israel.
